    AI Overview
    +31
    The term "fishes in the sea" refers to the vast array of saltwater fish that inhabit oceans and seas worldwide, encompassing thousands of different species with diverse sizes, behaviors, and habitats. Examples include iconic fish like the clownfish living in coral reefs, powerful predators such as the great white shark and swordfish, and abundant species like the Atlantic herring that form large schools.
     
    This video explains what fish are and introduces some common types of fish and their characteristics:
    52s
    Learn Bright
    YouTube · 25 Nov 2020
    Key Characteristics of Sea Fishes
    • Diversity:
      Sea fish include everything from tiny, abundant fish like Cyclothone to massive species like the whale shark, the largest fish in the sea. 
    • Habitat:
      They live in a wide range of environments, from the sunlit coral reefs to the deep ocean. 
    • Groups:
      Many sea fish live alone, while others form large "schools" for protection or to find food. 
    Examples of Sea Fishes
    • Coral Reef Fish:
      Clownfish, angelfish, and butterflyfish are well-known for their bright colors and life on coral reefs. 
    • Predators:
      Sharks, barracudas, and swordfish are powerful hunters. 
    • Deep-Sea Fish:
      The deep sea is home to unique species adapted to extreme conditions, such as the fangtooth and the anglerfish. 
    • Schooling Fish:
      Fish like the Atlantic herring and anchovies are often found in large groups. 
    You can watch this video to see various types of sea fish, including colorful reef fish and deep-sea creatures:
    58s
    Bisu's World
    YouTube · 30 May 2025
    Human Interaction 
    • Food Source: Many saltwater fish, like cod, salmon, and tuna, are caught for food or grown in aquaculture.
    • Aquariums: Numerous species are popular in aquariums and for recreational diving.

      Which fish are found in the sea?
      The lanternfish is, by far, the most common deep-sea fish. Other deep-sea fishes include the flashlight fish, cookiecutter shark, bristlemouths, anglerfish, viperfish, and some species of eelpout. Only about 2% of known marine species inhabit the pelagic environment.

      What is the most common sea fish?
      Cyclothone is believed to be the most abundant fish genus on Earth, with estimates that there are up to a quadrillion individuals (1015, or one million billion in the short scale). Their abundance is so large that they are also believed to be the most abundant genus of vertebrate on earth.
